messages:
elena: Quick thread to finalise GA acceptance checklist for the inference rollout. We need one-line green gates for: SLA text, public + internal docs, monitoring alerts + dashboards, oncall staffing, pricing/billing events, regression/eval coverage, and customer comms. Can each owner confirm and paste their single green criterion here?

matt: I'll own SLA wording + runtime perf targets. Green: public SLA page published + legal signoff and SLOs: hosted p99 <= 350ms, dedicated p95 <= 140ms, availability >= 99.95% (monthly).

rik: Observability owner. Green: GA dashboard live with per-route latency histograms, error-rate heatmap, kv-cache hit ratio; P1 alerts wired to PD and test alert firing verified. Example alert: `sum(rate(redwood_errors_total[5m]))/sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[5m])) > 0.015`

joy: Docs owner. Green: customer "what to expect" + developer quickstart + internal runbook uploaded to the docs site; includes API error codes, retry guidance, and rollback steps. Link will be posted when ready.

brian: Support/Oncall. Green: PagerDuty schedule created and staffed for 2 weeks post-GA (primary+backup), `#ga-launch-support` Slack channel exists, and triage runbook attached. We'll do a two-day warm handoff with support engineers.

sophia: Pricing/FinOps. Green: billing events emitted for every GA route with `ga_flag=true`, invoice-preview UI shows example month, and SKU mapping for token + request charges completed. Post a CSV schema to the board.

elena: Regression/evals: who owns prompt/regression checks? We need a short eval harness and a pass-rate gate.

matt: Runtime will run the smoke-suite: 5k synthetic requests across common routes with >= 98% exact-response-sanity and no P1 perf regressions vs baseline.

rik: Observability add-on: run a synthetic p99 baseline sweep overnight and confirm baseline_p99 values are stored. We'll use that for spike detection.

joy: Docs note: include a short "known issues" section and the rollback communications template so support can send consistent messages.

brian: Ops asks: freeze config changes 1h before cut, enable canary at 2% with manual approval for full ramp, and have an automated rollback trigger on P1.

sophia: Finance: tag GA customers with `ga_segment=true` so we can filter billing and reporting. Also need a limit for pilot discounts to auto-expire after threshold.

elena: Legal/compliance signoff? Any PII/data-retention blockers? Who to ping?

joy: I'll ping legal but we need the data retention table + sample logs for review.

matt: I'll attach the API error schema and sample logs to the launch board later today.

brian: Scheduling: propose a 48h smoke (low traffic) after cut, then 7-day close monitoring. If any P1 fires, pause ramp and run the postmortem checklist.

elena: OK action items: each owner paste their green gate and artifact link on the launch board by EOD tomorrow. Final gating sync Fri 09:30 PT. If anyone needs to swap, call it out here. :white_check_mark:
